title: Karwachauth ke din mai🫨 khane se bachna padega | #karwachauthspecial  #shorts #shivangithenayibahu
description:
🍛 Paneer Ki Sabji | पनीर की सब्ज़ी

**Ingredients सामग्री**
- Oil तेल
- Cumin seeds जीरा
- Whole spices खड़े मसाले
- Onion प्याज़
- Ginger-garlic paste अदरक-लहसुन का पेस्ट
- Tomato puree टमाटर की प्यूरी
- Curd दही
- Coriander powder धनिया पाउडर
- Black pepper powder काली मिर्च पाउडर
- Turmeric हल्दी
- Kashmiri red chilli powder कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर
- Paneer masala पनीर मसाला
- Salt & water नमक और पानी

Recipe | विधि

* Fry paneer in oil until golden brown. पनीर को तेल में सुनहरा होने तक तल लें।
* Heat oil in a pan, add cumin, whole spices, onion and ginger-garlic paste. Sauté well. पैन में तेल, जीरा, खड़े मसाले, प्याज़ और अदरक-लहसुन का पेस्ट डालकर भूनें।
* Add tomato puree and cook well. टमाटर की प्यूरी डालकर पकाएँ।
* Mix curd with coriander powder, black pepper, turmeric and Kashmiri red chilli powder. Add this mixture to the pan. दही में सभी सूखे मसाले मिलाकर पैन में डालें।
* Add a little water and cook. Then add fried paneer and paneer masala. Let it simmer. थोड़ा पानी डालकर पकाएँ, फिर तला हुआ पनीर और पनीर मसाला डालकर कुछ देर पकाएँ।
* Our delicious Paneer Ki Sabji is ready to serve! 😋

title: The FBI Wanted Answers From LEGO 🚨
description:
This Short is an original LEGO comedy concept built around a mechanical LEGO creation that produces the illusion of an endless domino effect, with the sequence appearing to continue without a final piece. I developed the storyline and turned the unusual mechanism into a joke about the FBI treating the build like a possible violation of the laws of physics. The FBI demands an explanation from LEGO, only for LEGO to immediately distance itself from the situation by pointing out that it only sells the bricks — and suggesting they arrest the person who actually built it. I transformed and restructured the source footage into my own comedic narrative and edited the full Short using After Effects and CapCut, including custom pacing, captions, motion, tracking, visual composition, transitions, and reaction elements. The humor comes from treating a clever but harmless LEGO mechanism like evidence of an impossible crime, while LEGO quickly shifts all responsibility onto the builder
